ابتنيتن (form VIII)
# اِبْتَنَيْتُنَّ (ibtanaytunna) /ib.ta.naj.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِبْتَنَى (ibtanā)
# اُبْتُنِيتُنَّ (ubtunītunna) /ub.tu.niː.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِبْتَنَى (ibtanā)
